01 — About the company

Built on trust. Driven by a modern fleet.

Founded with a vision to lead with excellence in the construction and transport industry, our work is rooted in integrity.

Fakhar Al Khaleej General Transport and Contracting L.L.C – S.P.C has built a reputation for professionalism, efficiency, and customer satisfaction across the UAE's construction and transport sector. Whether it's land excavation, steel erection, scaffolding solutions, or heavy transport logistics, we are committed to delivering value and sustainability in every task.

We combine experienced professionals, a modern fleet, and innovative solutions to provide efficient services tailored to our clients' needs — continuously investing in our people, equipment, and technology to ensure excellence in every aspect of our business.

Setting the standard we build to.

03 — Our services

Transport and contracting, under one roof.

From heavy vehicle transport to structural steel, our service lines cover the full lifecycle of a site — supply, groundwork, build, and logistics.

General Transport

Proven, multi-model, cost-effective transport routes across the UAE with a fleet of loaders, graders, trailers and tippers.

General Contracting

End-to-end residential, commercial and industrial construction from foundation to finishing.

Excavation Works

Land clearing, trenching, backfilling and site preparation using advanced machinery and skilled operators.

Scaffolding Works

Safe, compliant scaffolding for building, industrial, structural and maintenance projects — supply through dismantling.

Steel Fabrication

Steel reinforcement, structural steel installation and steel structural works built for strength and precision.

Earth Works

Excavation, compaction, dozing, ripping, grading and levelling backed by a specialized mechanical fleet.

Logistics Services

Site support, manpower and equipment coordination that keeps multi-party projects moving on schedule.

Material Supply

Steel & metal, bricks & blocks, cement & binders, sand, gravel and timber to the highest quality standard.

Backfilling Works

Precision backfilling and site restoration completed with minimal disruption to surrounding works.

Levelling & Compaction

Durable, reliable grading and compaction as the finishing step before every build.

Infrastructure Works

Road networks, bridges, underground utilities and pipeline installation delivered on time.
